[[Shield Gate]] above [[Scarif]]''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'' |species=[[Human]] |gender=[[Gender|Male]] |pronouns=new |height= |mass= |hair=[[Color|Brown]] |feathers= |eyes= |skin=Light |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=*[[Galactic Empire]] **[[Imperial Navy]] ***[[Gate Control]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|Cargo shuttle SW-0608, you're not listed on the arrival schedule.''"
"''Acknowledged, Gate Control. We were rerouted from Eadu flight station.|The gate officer and [[Bodhi Rook]]|}} During the [[Battle of Scarif]], an [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] '''[[gate officer]]''' wearing a [[captain]]'s{{Instagram|username=glyn__dillon|url=p/BcDdpV7BNP1|name=[[Glyn Dillon]]|quote=I sometimes get asked, on Twitter, about certain things to do with the details of Star Wars costumes, especially Imperial costumes. I try to answer as best I can but I can't always remember... 'ranking' is something that crops up every now and then ...so I've been meaning to post this on here for a while. My co-designer, David Crossman is a military expert, much like John Mollo was, so this is something he put together, after studying all the OT films and working out what he thought John Mollo was doing with the Imperial ranking. It was devised for Rogue One... and if there are any Imperials in Solo, we would've have used this system again... But obviously I can't say if we did 😜 I hope it's useful for all the cosplayers and costumers out there|archiveurl=https://m.imgur.com/C05Pmj5}} [[rank insignia plaque]] with a row of four blue squares worked on the [[Shield Gate]] above [[Scarif]] as part of [[Gate Control]]. In [[1 BBY]], the officer informed the incoming Imperial [[Zeta-class Heavy Cargo Shuttle|''Zeta''-class Heavy Cargo Shuttle]] ''[[SW-0608]]'' that they were not on the manifest. [[Bodhi Rook|The pilot]] responded that they had been re-routed from the [[Mission to Eadu|recently attacked]] [[Eadu Flight Station]] and transmitted the proper clearance codes, which this officer confirmed. Unknown to him, the cargo shuttle secretly held a commando team of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebels]] led by [[Jyn Erso]], who intended to infiltrate the [[Scarif vault|facility]] on the [[planet]] and steal the [[Death Star plans]]. Later on the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Rebel fleet]] arrived and and [[Battle of Scarif|engaged]] the Imperial [[Imperial Navy|fleet]] orbiting the planet. [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Blue Squadron]] was tasked with getting to the planet's surface and began passing through the still open shield gate. The officer frantically scrambled to close the shield gate, which was still blocked by a passing ''Zeta''-class shuttle, but allowed multiple fighters to pass through before managing to close the managed to energy field. The officer was [[Death|killed]] when the remnants of the ''[[Persecutor]]'' and the ''[[Intimidator]]'', two [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|Imperial star destroyers]] disabled in the battle, where pushed by the [[Sphyrna-class Hammerhead corvette|''Sphyrna''-class Hammerhead corvette]] ''[[Lightmaker]]'' into the gate and destroyed it. {{Char-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== The character appeared in the [[2016]] film ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'', where they were portrayed by [[Michael Nardone]], who was credited as "Shield Gate Officer". ==Appearances== *''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'' {{1st}} *[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story (novelization)|''Rogue One: A Star Wars Story'' novelization]] {{Ab|Rogue One: A Star Wars Story (audiobook)}} {{Voice}} *''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: A Junior Novel]]'' {{Ab|Star Wars: Rogue One: A Junior Novel (audiobook)}} {{Voice}} *[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story Graphic Novel Adaptation|''Rogue One: A Star Wars Story'' Graphic Novel Adaptation]] {{Voice}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=ფარის კარის უცნობი ოფიცერი |uk=Невстановлений капітан шлюзу щита }} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Imperial Navy officers of the Galactic Empire]] [[Category:Imperial Navy Troopers]] [[Category:Males]]
